title: DraftSave
description: Command: API asks the engine to store a draft in the account's Drafts folder, replacing its previous version. Without text and recipients it only deletes the draft.

inReplyTo.description: Message-ID header of the message this answers, for the thread headers.

discard.description: Delete the draft instead of storing it.

rev.description: When the client wrote this version, in milliseconds; an older one arriving late is dropped.

attachments.description: Files uploaded through the API, stored in S3 as upload/<accountId>/<id>.

html.description: An HTML version next to the text, like a forwarded message with its formatting.
